ADAPTABILITY.name: Adaptability
ADAPTABILITY.desc: Powers up moves of the same type.

AERILATE.name: Aerilate
AERILATE.desc: Normal-type moves become Flying-type and power up.

AFTERMATH.name: Aftermath
AFTERMATH.desc: Damages the attacker landing the finishing hit.

ANALYTIC.name: Analytic
ANALYTIC.desc: Boosts move power when the Pokémon moves last.

ANGERPOINT.name: Anger Point
ANGERPOINT.desc: Maxes Attack after taking a critical hit.

ANGERSHELL.name: Anger Shell
ANGERSHELL.desc: When an attack causes its HP to drop to half or less, the Pokémon gets angry. This lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.

ARMORTAIL.name: Armor Tail
ARMORTAIL.desc: The mysterious tail covering the Pokémon's head makes opponents unable to use priority moves against the Pokémon or its allies.

AROMAVEIL.name: Aroma Veil
AROMAVEIL.desc: Protects against attacks that limit move choices.

ASONE.name: As One
ASONE.desc: This Ability combines the effects of both Calyrex's Unnerve Ability and Glastrier's Chilling Neigh Ability.

AURABREAK.name: Aura Break
AURABREAK.desc: Reverses \"Aura\" Abilities to weaken affected moves.

AURAGUARD.name: Aura Guard
AURAGUARD.desc: A Pokémon with Aura Guard takes half damage from moves that make contact. Moves affected by Long Reach which make contact will deal regular damage.

BALLFETCH.name: Ball Fetch
BALLFETCH.desc: If the Pokémon is not holding an item, it will fetch the Poké Ball from the first failed throw of the battle.

BATTERY.name: Battery
BATTERY.desc: Powers up ally Pokémon's special moves.

BATTLEARMOR.name: Battle Armor
BATTLEARMOR.desc: The Pokémon is protected against critical hits.

BATTLEBOND.name: Battle Bond
BATTLEBOND.desc: Defeating a foe lets it become Ash-Greninja.

BEADSOFRUIN.name: Beads of Ruin
BEADSOFRUIN.desc: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous beads lowers the Sp. Def stats of all Pokémon except itself.

BEASTBOOST.name: Beast Boost
BEASTBOOST.desc: Boosts its best stat each time it deals a KO.

BERSERK.name: Berserk
BERSERK.desc: Ups Sp. Atk if a hit makes its HP half or less.

BLAZE.name: Blaze
BLAZE.desc: Powers up Fire-type moves in a pinch.

BULLETPROOF.name: Bulletproof
BULLETPROOF.desc: Protects the Pokémon from some ball and bomb moves.

CHEEKPOUCH.name: Cheek Pouch
CHEEKPOUCH.desc: Restores HP as well when the Pokémon eats a Berry.

CHILLINGNEIGH.name: Chilling Neigh
CHILLINGNEIGH.desc: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a chilling neigh, which boosts its Attack stat.

CHLOROPHYLL.name: Chlorophyll
CHLOROPHYLL.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed in sunshine.

CLEARBODY.name: Clear Body
CLEARBODY.desc: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.

COLORCHANGE.name: Color Change
COLORCHANGE.desc: Changes the Pokémon's type to the foe's move.

COMATOSE.name: Comatose
COMATOSE.desc: It's always drowsing, and attacks without waking.

COMMANDER.name: Commander
COMMANDER.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it goes inside the mouth of an ally Dondozo if one is on the field. The Pokémon then issues commands from there.

COMPETITIVE.name: Competitive
COMPETITIVE.desc: Sharply boosts Sp. Atk when a stat is lowered.

CONTRARY.name: Contrary
CONTRARY.desc: Makes stat changes have an opposite effect.

CORROSION.name: Corrosion
CORROSION.desc: It can poison Steel- and Poison-type targets.

COSTAR.name: Costar
COSTAR.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it copies an ally's stat changes.

COTTONDOWN.name: Cotton Down
COTTONDOWN.desc: When the Pokémon is hit by an attack, it scatters cotton fluff around and lowers the Speed stat of all Pokémon except itself

CUDCHEW.name: Cud Chew
CUDCHEW.desc: When the Pokémon eats a Berry, it will regurgitate that Berry at the end of the next turn and eat it one more time.

CURIOUSMEDICINE.name: Curious Medicine
CURIOUSMEDICINE.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it scatters medicine from its shell, which removes all stat changes from allies.

CURSEDBODY.name: Cursed Body
CURSEDBODY.desc: May disable a move used on the Pokémon.

CUTECHARM.name: Cute Charm
CUTECHARM.desc: Contact with the Pokémon may cause infatuation.

DAMP.name: Damp
DAMP.desc: Prevents the use of self-destructing moves.

DANCER.name: Dancer
DANCER.desc: Repeats another Pokémon's dance move immediately.

DARKAURA.name: Dark Aura
DARKAURA.desc: Powers up each Pokémon's Dark-type moves.

DAUNTLESSSHIELD.name: Dauntless Shield
DAUNTLESSSHIELD.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Defense stat when the Pokémon enters a battle.

DAZZLING.name: Dazzling
DAZZLING.desc: Makes foes unable to use priority attacks.

DEFEATIST.name: Defeatist
DEFEATIST.desc: Lowers stats when HP becomes half or less.

DEFIANT.name: Defiant
DEFIANT.desc: When its stats are lowered its Attack increases.

DELTASTREAM.name: Delta Stream
DELTASTREAM.desc: Alters weather to remove Flying-type's weaknesses.

DESOLATELAND.name: Desolate Land
DESOLATELAND.desc: Changes the weather to nullify Water-type moves.

DISGUISE.name: Disguise
DISGUISE.desc: Its shroud protects it from an attack just once.

DOWNLOAD.name: Download
DOWNLOAD.desc: Adjusts power according to a foe's defenses.

DRAGONIZE.name: Dragonize
DRAGONIZE.desc: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.

DRIZZLE.name: Drizzle
DRIZZLE.desc: The Pokémon makes it rain if it appears in battle.

DROUGHT.name: Drought
DROUGHT.desc: Turns the sunlight harsh if it is in battle.

DRYSKIN.name: Dry Skin
DRYSKIN.desc: Reduces HP if it is hot. Water restores HP.

EARLYBIRD.name: Early Bird
EARLYBIRD.desc: The Pokémon awakens quickly from sleep.

EARTHEATER.name: Earth Eater
EARTHEATER.desc: If hit by a Ground-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.

EELEVATE.name: Eelevate
EELEVATE.desc: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as the Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web statuses. When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, its highest stat is boosted by 1 stage.

EFFECTSPORE.name: Effect Spore
EFFECTSPORE.desc: Contact may poison or cause paralysis or sleep.

ELECTRICSURGE.name: Electric Surge
ELECTRICSURGE.desc: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain.

ELECTROMORPHOSIS.name: Electromorphosis
ELECTROMORPHOSIS.desc: The Pokémon becomes charged when it takes damage, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

EMBODYASPECT.name: Embody Aspect
EMBODYASPECT.desc: The Pokémon's heart fills with memories, causing the Mask to shine and one of the Pokémon's stats to be boosted.

EMERGENCYEXIT.name: Emergency Exit
EMERGENCYEXIT.desc: Switches out if its HP becomes half or less.

FAIRYAURA.name: Fairy Aura
FAIRYAURA.desc: Powers up each Pokémon's Fairy-type moves.

FIREMANE.name: Fire Mane
FIREMANE.desc: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Fire-type moves by 50%.

FLAMEBODY.name: Flame Body
FLAMEBODY.desc: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.

FLAREBOOST.name: Flare Boost
FLAREBOOST.desc: Powers up special attacks when burned.

FLASHFIRE.name: Flash Fire
FLASHFIRE.desc: It powers up Fire-type moves if it's hit by one.

FLOWERGIFT.name: Flower Gift
FLOWERGIFT.desc: Powers up party Pokémon when it is sunny.

FLOWERVEIL.name: Flower Veil
FLOWERVEIL.desc: Protects Grass-type allies from stat/status effects.

FLUFFY.name: Fluffy
FLUFFY.desc: Resists contact damage but weaker to Fire-type.

FOREWARN.name: Forewarn
FOREWARN.desc: Determines what moves a foe has.

FRISK.name: Frisk
FRISK.desc: The Pokémon can check a foe's held item.

FULLMETALBODY.name: Full Metal Body
FULLMETALBODY.desc: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.

FURCOAT.name: Fur Coat
FURCOAT.desc: Halves the damage from physical moves.

GALEWINGS.name: Gale Wings
GALEWINGS.desc: Flying-type moves gain priority when its HP is full.

GALVANIZE.name: Galvanize
GALVANIZE.desc: Normal-type moves become Electric-type and powered.

GLUTTONY.name: Gluttony
GLUTTONY.desc: Encourages the early use of a held Berry.

GOODASGOLD.name: Good as Gold
GOODASGOLD.desc: A body of pure, solid gold gives the Pokémon full immunity to other Pokémon's status moves.

GOOEY.name: Gooey
GOOEY.desc: Contact with it lowers the attacker's Speed stat.

GORILLATACTICS.name: Gorilla Tactica
GORILLATACTICS.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat but only allows the use of the first selected move.

GRASSPELT.name: Grass Pelt
GRASSPELT.desc: Boosts the Defense stat on Grassy Terrain.

GRASSYSURGE.name: Grassy Surge
GRASSYSURGE.desc: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain.

GRIMNEIGH.name: Grim Neigh
GRIMNEIGH.desc: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it utters a terrifying neigh, which boosts its Sp. Atk stat.

GUARDDOG.name: Guard Dog
GUARDDOG.desc: Boosts the Pokémon’s Attack stat if intimidated. Moves and items that would force the Pokémon to switch out also fail to work.

GULPMISSILE.name: Gulp Missile
GULPMISSILE.desc: When the Pokémon sues Surf or Dive, it will come back with prey. When it takes damage, it will spit out the prey to attack.

GUTS.name: Guts
GUTS.desc: Boosts Attack if there is a status problem.

HADRONENGINE.name: Hadron Engine
HADRONENGINE.desc: Turns the ground into Electric Terrain when the Pokémon enters a battle. The futuristic engine within the Pokémon also boosts its Sp. Atk stat on Electric Terrain.

HARVEST.name: Harvest
HARVEST.desc: May create another Berry after one is used.

HEALER.name: Healer
HEALER.desc: May heal an ally's status conditions.

HEATPROOF.name: Heatproof
HEATPROOF.desc: Weakens the power of Fire-type moves.

HONEYGATHER.name: Honey Gather
HONEYGATHER.desc: The Pokémon may gather Honey from somewhere.

HOSPITALITY.name: Hospitality
HOSPITALITY.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it showers its ally with hospitality, restoring a small amount of the ally's HP

HUNGERSWITCH.name: Hunger Switch
HUNGERSWITCH.desc: The Pokémon changes its form, alternating between its Fully Belly Mode and Hangry Mode after the end of each turn.

HUSTLE.name: Hustle
HUSTLE.desc: Boosts the Attack stat, but lowers accuracy.

HYDRATION.name: Hydration
HYDRATION.desc: Heals status problems if it is raining.

HYPERCUTTER.name: Hyper Cutter
HYPERCUTTER.desc: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering Attack stat.

ICEBODY.name: Ice Body
ICEBODY.desc: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in a hailstorm.

ICEFACE.name: Ice Face
ICEFACE.desc: The Pokémon's ice head can take a physical attack as a substitute, but this attack also changes the Pokémon's appearance. The ice will be restored when it hails.

ICESCALES.name: Ice Scales
ICESCALES.desc: The Pokémon is protected by ice scales, which halve the damage taken from special moves.

ILLUMINATE.name: Illuminate
ILLUMINATE.desc: Raises the likelihood of meeting wild Pokémon.

ILLUSION.name: Illusion
ILLUSION.desc: Comes out disguised as the Pokémon in back.

IMMUNITY.name: Immunity
IMMUNITY.desc: Prevents the Pokémon from getting poisoned.

IMPOSTER.name: Imposter
IMPOSTER.desc: It transforms itself into the Pokémon it is facing.

INFILTRATOR.name: Infiltrator
INFILTRATOR.desc: Passes through the foe's barrier and strikes.

INNARDSOUT.name: Innards Out
INNARDSOUT.desc: Damages an attacker that lands the finishing hit.

INNERFOCUS.name: Inner Focus
INNERFOCUS.desc: The Pokémon is protected from flinching.

INSOMNIA.name: Insomnia
INSOMNIA.desc: Prevents the Pokémon from falling asleep.

INTREPIDSWORD.name: Interpid Sword
INTREPIDSWORD.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat when the Pokémon enters a battle.

IRONBARBS.name: Iron Barbs
IRONBARBS.desc: Inflicts damage to the Pokémon on contact.

IRONFIST.name: Iron Fist
IRONFIST.desc: Boosts the power of punching moves.

JUSTIFIED.name: Justified
JUSTIFIED.desc: Raises Attack when hit by a Dark-type move.

KEENEYE.name: Keen Eye
KEENEYE.desc: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering accuracy.

KLUTZ.name: Klutz
KLUTZ.desc: The Pokémon can't use any held items.

LEAFGUARD.name: Leaf Guard
LEAFGUARD.desc: Prevents problems with status in sunny weather.

LEVITATE.name: Levitate
LEVITATE.desc: Gives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.

LIBERO.name: Libero
LIBERO.desc: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use.

LIGHTNINGROD.name: Lightning Rod
LIGHTNINGROD.desc: Draws in all Electric-type moves to up Sp. Attack.

LIMBER.name: Limber
LIMBER.desc: The Pokémon is protected from paralysis.

LINGERINGAROMA.name: Lingering Aroma
LINGERINGAROMA.desc: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Lingering Aroma.

LIQUIDOOZE.name: Liquid Ooze
LIQUIDOOZE.desc: Damages attackers using any draining move.

LONGREACH.name: Long Reach
LONGREACH.desc: Uses moves without making contact with the target.

MAGICGUARD.name: Magic Guard
MAGICGUARD.desc: The Pokémon only takes damage from attacks.

MAGICIAN.name: Magician
MAGICIAN.desc: Steals the held item of a Pokémon it hits.

MAGMAARMOR.name: Magma Armor
MAGMAARMOR.desc: Prevents the Pokémon from becoming frozen.

MARVELSCALE.name: Marvel Scale
MARVELSCALE.desc: Ups Defense if there is a status problem.

MEGALAUNCHER.name: Mega Launcher
MEGALAUNCHER.desc: Powers up aura and pulse moves.

MEGASOL.name: Mega Sol
MEGASOL.desc: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.

MERCILESS.name: Merciless
MERCILESS.desc: Its attacks are critical hits when it is poisoned.

MIMICRY.name: Mimicry
MIMICRY.desc: Changes the Pokémon's type depending on the terrain.

MINDSEYE.name: Mind’s Eye
MINDSEYE.desc: The Pokémon ignores changes to opponents' evasiveness, its accuracy can't be lowered, and it can hit Ghost types with Normal-type and Fighting-type moves

MINUS.name: Minus
MINUS.desc: Ups Sp. Atk if another Pokémon has Plus or Minus.

MIRRORARMOR.name: Mirror Armor
MIRRORARMOR.desc: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effets that the Pokémon receives.

MISTYSURGE.name: Misty Surge
MISTYSURGE.desc: Turns the ground into Misty Terrain.

MOLDBREAKER.name: Mold Breaker
MOLDBREAKER.desc: Moves can be used regardless of Abilities.

MOODY.name: Moody
MOODY.desc: Raises one stat and lowers another.

MOTORDRIVE.name: Motor Drive
MOTORDRIVE.desc: Raises Speed if hit by an Electric-type move.

MOXIE.name: Moxie
MOXIE.desc: Boosts Attack after knocking out any Pokémon.

MULTISCALE.name: Multiscale
MULTISCALE.desc: Reduces damage when HP is full.

MULTITYPE.name: Multitype
MULTITYPE.desc: Changes type to match the held Plate.

MUMMY.name: Mummy
MUMMY.desc: Contact with this Pokémon spreads this Ability.

MYCELIUMMIGHT.name: Mycelium Might
MYCELIUMMIGHT.desc: The Pokémon will always act more slowly when using status moves, but these moves will be unimpeded by the Ability of the target.

NATURALCURE.name: Natural Cure
NATURALCURE.desc: All status problems heal when it switches out.

NEUROFORCE.name: Neuroforce
NEUROFORCE.desc: Powers up moves that are super-effective.

NEUTRALIZINGGAS.name: Neutralizing Gas
NEUTRALIZINGGAS.desc: If the Pokémon with Neutralizing Gas is in Battle, the effects of all Pokémon's Abilities will be nullified or will not be triggered

NOGUARD.name: No Guard
NOGUARD.desc: Ensures attacks by or against the Pokémon land.

NORMALIZE.name: Normalize
NORMALIZE.desc: All the Pokémon's moves become the Normal type.

OPPORTUNIST.name: Opportunist
OPPORTUNIST.desc: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.

ORICHALCUMPULSE.name: Orichalcum Pulse
ORICHALCUMPULSE.desc: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters a battle. The ancient pulse thrumming through the Pokémon also boosts its Attack stat in harsh sunlight.

OVERCOAT.name: Overcoat
OVERCOAT.desc: Protects the Pokémon from damage from weather.

OVERGROW.name: Overgrow
OVERGROW.desc: Powers up Grass-type moves in a pinch.

OWNTEMPO.name: Own Tempo
OWNTEMPO.desc: Prevents the Pokémon from becoming confused.

PASTELVEIL.name: Pastel Veil
PASTELVEIL.desc: Protects the Pokémon and its ally Pokémon from being poisoned.

PERISHBODY.name: Perish Body
PERISHBODY.desc: When hit by a move that makes direct contact, the Pokémon and the attacker will faint after three turns unless they switch out of battle.

PICKPOCKET.name: Pickpocket
PICKPOCKET.desc: Steals an item when hit by another Pokémon.

PICKUP.name: Pickup
PICKUP.desc: The Pokémon may pick up items.

PIERCINGDRILL.name: Piercing Drill
PIERCINGDRILL.desc: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.

PIXILATE.name: Pixilate
PIXILATE.desc: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type and powered up.

PLUS.name: Plus
PLUS.desc: Ups Sp. Atk if another Pokémon has Plus or Minus.

POISONHEAL.name: Poison Heal
POISONHEAL.desc: Restores HP if the Pokémon is poisoned.

POISONPOINT.name: Poison Point
POISONPOINT.desc: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.

POISONPUPPETEER.name: Poison Puppeteer
POISONPUPPETEER.desc: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.

POISONTOUCH.name: Poison Touch
POISONTOUCH.desc: May poison targets when a Pokémon makes contact.

POWERCONSTRUCT.name: Power Construct
POWERCONSTRUCT.desc: Changes with other Cells if HP becomes half or less.

POWEROFALCHEMY.name: Power of Alchemy
POWEROFALCHEMY.desc: Copies the Ability of a defeated ally.

POWERSPOT.name: Power Spot
POWERSPOT.desc: Just being next to the Pokémon powers up moves.

PRANKSTER.name: Prankster
PRANKSTER.desc: Gives priority to a status move.

PRESSURE.name: Pressure
PRESSURE.desc: The Pokémon raises the foe's PP usage.

PRIMORDIALSEA.name: Primordial Sea
PRIMORDIALSEA.desc: Changes the weather to nullify Fire-type moves.

PROPELLERTAIL.name: Propeller Tail
PROPELLERTAIL.desc: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

PROTEAN.name: Protean
PROTEAN.desc: It changes type to that of the move it's about to use.

PROTOSYNTHESIS.name: Protosynthesis
PROTOSYNTHESIS.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat in harsh sunlight or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

PSYCHICSURGE.name: Psychic Surge
PSYCHICSURGE.desc: Turns the ground into Psychic Terrain.

PUNKROCK.name: Punk Rock
PUNKROCK.desc: Boosts the power of sound-based moves. The Pokémon also takes half the damage from these kinds of moves.

PURIFYINGSALT.name: Purifying Salt
PURIFYINGSALT.desc: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.

QUARKDRIVE.name: Quark Drive
QUARKDRIVE.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's most proficient stat on Electric Terrain or if the Pokémon is holding Booster Energy.

QUEENLYMAJESTY.name: Queenly Majesty
QUEENLYMAJESTY.desc: Makes foes unable to use priority attacks.

QUICKDRAW.name: Quick Draw
QUICKDRAW.desc: Enables the Pokémon to move first occasionally.

QUICKFEET.name: Quick Feet
QUICKFEET.desc: Boosts Speed if there is a status problem.

RAINDISH.name: Rain Dish
RAINDISH.desc: The Pokémon gradually regains HP in rain.

RATTLED.name: Rattled
RATTLED.desc: Some move types scare it and boost its Speed.

RECEIVER.name: Receiver
RECEIVER.desc: Copies the Ability of a defeated ally.

RECKLESS.name: Reckless
RECKLESS.desc: Powers up moves that have recoil damage.

REFRIGERATE.name: Refrigerate
REFRIGERATE.desc: Normal-type moves become Ice-type and powered up.

REGENERATOR.name: Regenerator
REGENERATOR.desc: Restores a little HP when withdrawn from battle.

RIPEN.name: Ripen
RIPEN.desc: Ripens Berries and doubles their effect.

RIVALRY.name: Rivalry
RIVALRY.desc: Deals more damage to a foe of the same gender.

RKSSYSTEM.name: RKS System
RKSSYSTEM.desc: Its type matches the memory disc it holds.

ROCKHEAD.name: Rock Head
ROCKHEAD.desc: Protects the Pokémon from recoil damage.

ROUGHSKIN.name: Rough Skin
ROUGHSKIN.desc: Inflicts damage to the foe on contact.

RUNAWAY.name: Run Away
RUNAWAY.desc: Enables a sure getaway from wild Pokémon.

SANDFORCE.name: Sand Force
SANDFORCE.desc: Boosts certain moves' power in a sandstorm.

SANDRUSH.name: Sand Rush
SANDRUSH.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed in a sandstorm.

SANDSPIT.name: Sand Spit
SANDSPIT.desc: The Pokémon creates a Sandstorm when hit by an attack.

SANDSTREAM.name: Sand Stream
SANDSTREAM.desc: The Pokémon summons a sandstorm in battle.

SANDVEIL.name: Sand Veil
SANDVEIL.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's evasion in a sandstorm.

SAPSIPPER.name: Sap Sipper
SAPSIPPER.desc: Boosts Attack when hit by a Grass-type move.

SCHOOLING.name: Schooling
SCHOOLING.desc: Forms a powerful school while it has a lot of HP.

SCRAPPY.name: Scrappy
SCRAPPY.desc: Enables moves to hit Ghost-type Pokémon.

SCREENCLEANER.name: Screen Cleaner
SCREENCLEANER.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, the effects of Light Screen, Reflect and Aurora Veil are nullified for both opposing and ally Pokémon

SEEDSOWER.name: Seed Sower
SEEDSOWER.desc: Turns the ground into Grassy Terrain when the Pokémon is hit by an attack.

SERENEGRACE.name: Serene Grace
SERENEGRACE.desc: Boosts the likelihood of added effects appearing.

SHADOWSHIELD.name: Shadow Shield
SHADOWSHIELD.desc: Resists damage while its HP is full.

SHEDSKIN.name: Shed Skin
SHEDSKIN.desc: The Pokémon may heal its own status problems.

SHEERFORCE.name: Sheer Force
SHEERFORCE.desc: Removes added effects to increase move damage.

SHELLARMOR.name: Shell Armor
SHELLARMOR.desc: The Pokémon is protected against critical hits.

SHIELDDUST.name: Shield Dust
SHIELDDUST.desc: Blocks the added effects of attacks taken.

SHIELDSDOWN.name: Shields Down
SHIELDSDOWN.desc: Its shell breaks if its HP becomes half or less.

SIMPLE.name: Simple
SIMPLE.desc: The Pokémon is prone to wild stat changes.

SKILLLINK.name: Skill Link
SKILLLINK.desc: Increases the frequency of multi-strike moves.

SLUSHRUSH.name: Slush Rush
SLUSHRUSH.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat in a hailstorm.

SNIPER.name: Sniper
SNIPER.desc: Powers up moves if they become critical hits.

SNOWWARNING.name: Snow Warning
SNOWWARNING.desc: The Pokémon summons a hailstorm in battle.

SOLARPOWER.name: Solar Power
SOLARPOWER.desc: In sunshine, Sp. Atk is boosted but HP decreases.

SOULHEART.name: Soul-Heart
SOULHEART.desc: Boosts Sp. Atk each time a Pokémon faints.

SOUNDPROOF.name: Soundproof
SOUNDPROOF.desc: Gives full immunity to all sound-based moves.

SPEEDBOOST.name: Speed Boost
SPEEDBOOST.desc: Its Speed stat is gradually boosted.

SPICYSPRAY.name: Spicy Spray
SPICYSPRAY.desc: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.

STAKEOUT.name: Stakeout
STAKEOUT.desc: Deals doubles damage to a target's replacement.

STALL.name: Stall
STALL.desc: The Pokémon moves after all other Pokémon do.

STALWART.name: Stalwart
STALWART.desc: Ignores the effects of opposing Pokémon's Abilities and moves that draw in moves.

STAMINA.name: Stamina
STAMINA.desc: Boosts Defense when hit by an attack.

STANCECHANGE.name: Stance Change
STANCECHANGE.desc: Changes between Blade and Shield Forme with attacks.

STATIC.name: Static
STATIC.desc: Contact with the Pokémon may cause paralysis.

STEADFAST.name: Steadfast
STEADFAST.desc: Raises Speed each time the Pokémon flinches.

STEAMENGINE.name: Steam Engine
STEAMENGINE.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed stat drastically if hit by a Fire- or Water-type move.

STEELYSPIRIT.name: Steely Spirit
STEELYSPIRIT.desc: Powers up ally Pokémon's Steel-type moves.

STENCH.name: Stench
STENCH.desc: The stench may cause the target to flinch.

STICKYHOLD.name: Sticky Hold
STICKYHOLD.desc: Protects the Pokémon from item theft.

STORMDRAIN.name: Storm Drain
STORMDRAIN.desc: Draws in all Water-type moves to up Sp. Attack.

STRONGJAW.name: Strong Jaw
STRONGJAW.desc: Boosts the power of biting moves.

STURDY.name: Sturdy
STURDY.desc: It cannot be knocked out with one hit.

SUCTIONCUPS.name: Suction Cups
SUCTIONCUPS.desc: Negates all moves that force switching out.

SUPERLUCK.name: Super Luck
SUPERLUCK.desc: Heightens the critical-hit ratios of moves.

SUPERSWEETSYRUP.name: Supersweet Syrup
SUPERSWEETSYRUP.desc: Lowers the evasion of opposing Pokémon by 1 stage when first sent into battle

SUPREMEOVERLORD.name: Supreme Overlord
SUPREMEOVERLORD.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, its Attack and Sp. Atk stats are slightly boosted for each of the allies in its party that have already been defeated.

SWARM.name: Swarm
SWARM.desc: Powers up Bug-type moves in a pinch.

SWEETVEIL.name: Sweet Veil
SWEETVEIL.desc: Prevents itself and allies from falling asleep.

SWIFTSWIM.name: Swift Swim
SWIFTSWIM.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Speed in rain.

SWORDOFRUIN.name: Sword of Ruin
SWORDOFRUIN.desc: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous sword lowers the Defense stats of all Pokémon except itself.

SYMBIOSIS.name: Symbiosis
SYMBIOSIS.desc: Passes its held item to an ally that has used theirs.

SYNCHRONIZE.name: Synchronize
SYNCHRONIZE.desc: Passes a burn, poison, or paralysis to the foe.

TABLETSOFRUIN.name: Tablets of Ruin
TABLETSOFRUIN.desc: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous wooden tablets lowers the Attack stats of all Pokémon except itself.

TANGLEDFEET.name: Tangled Feet
TANGLEDFEET.desc: Raises evasion if the Pokémon is confused.

TANGLINGHAIR.name: Tangling Hair
TANGLINGHAIR.desc: Contact with it lowers the attacker's Speed.

TECHNICIAN.name: Technician
TECHNICIAN.desc: Powers up the Pokémon's weaker moves.

TELEPATHY.name: Telepathy
TELEPATHY.desc: Anticipates an ally's attack and dodges it.

TERAFORMZERO.name: Teraform Zero
TERAFORMZERO.desc: When Terapagos changes into its Stellar Form, it uses its hidden powers to eliminate all effects of weather and terrain, reducing them to zero.

TERASHELL.name: Tera Shell
TERASHELL.desc: The Pokémon's shell contains the powers of each type. All damage-dealing moves that hit the Pokémon when its HP is full will not be very effective.

TERASHIFT.name: Tera Shift
TERASHIFT.desc: When the Pokémon enters a battle, it absorbs the energy around itself and transforms into its Terastal Form.

TERAVOLT.name: Teravolt
TERAVOLT.desc: Moves can be used regardless of Abilities.

THERMALEXCHANGE.name: Thermal Exchange
THERMALEXCHANGE.desc: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.

THICKFAT.name: Thick Fat
THICKFAT.desc: Ups resistance to Fire- and Ice-type moves.

TORRENT.name: Torrent
TORRENT.desc: Powers up Water-type moves in a pinch.

TOUGHCLAWS.name: Tough Claws
TOUGHCLAWS.desc: Powers up moves that make direct contact.

TOXICBOOST.name: Toxic Boost
TOXICBOOST.desc: Powers up physical attacks when poisoned.

TOXICCHAIN.name: Toxic Chain
TOXICCHAIN.desc: The power of the Pokémon's toxic chain may badly poison any target the Pokémon hits with a move

TOXICDEBRIS.name: Toxic Debris
TOXICDEBRIS.desc: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.

TRACE.name: Trace
TRACE.desc: The Pokémon copies a foe's Ability.

TRIAGE.name: Triage
TRIAGE.desc: Gives priority to a healing move.

TRUANT.name: Truant
TRUANT.desc: Pokémon can't attack on consecutive turns.

TURBOBLAZE.name: Turboblaze
TURBOBLAZE.desc: Moves can be used regardless of Abilities.

UNAWARE.name: Unaware
UNAWARE.desc: Ignores any stat changes in the Pokémon.

UNBURDEN.name: Unburden
UNBURDEN.desc: Raises Speed if a held item is used.

UNNERVE.name: Unnerve
UNNERVE.desc: Makes the foe nervous and unable to eat Berries.

UNSEENFIST.name: Unseen Fist
UNSEENFIST.desc: If the Pokémon uses moves that make direct contact, it can attack the target even if the target protects itself.

VESSELOFRUIN.name: Vessel of Ruin
VESSELOFRUIN.desc: The power of the Pokémon's ruinous vessel lowers the Sp. Atk stats of all Pokémon except itself.

VICTORYSTAR.name: Victory Star
VICTORYSTAR.desc: Boosts the accuracy of its allies and itself.

VITALSPIRIT.name: Vital Spirit
VITALSPIRIT.desc: Prevents the Pokémon from falling asleep.

VOLTABSORB.name: Volt Absorb
VOLTABSORB.desc: Restores HP if hit by an Electric-type move.

WANDERINGSPIRIT.name: Wandering Spirit
WANDERINGSPIRIT.desc: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.

WATERABSORB.name: Water Absorb
WATERABSORB.desc: Restores HP if hit by a Water-type move.

WATERBUBBLE.name: Water Bubble
WATERBUBBLE.desc: Weakens incoming Fire-type moves and prevents burns.

WATERCOMPACTION.name: Water Compaction
WATERCOMPACTION.desc: Sharply ups Defense when hit by a Water-type move.

WATERVEIL.name: Water Veil
WATERVEIL.desc: Prevents the Pokémon from getting a burn.

WEAKARMOR.name: Weak Armor
WEAKARMOR.desc: Physical attacks lower Defense and raise Speed.

WELLBAKEDBODY.name: Well-Baked Body
WELLBAKEDBODY.desc: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Fire-type moves. Instead, its Defense stat is sharply boosted.

WHITESMOKE.name: White Smoke
WHITESMOKE.desc: Prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.

WIMPOUT.name: Wimp Out
WIMPOUT.desc: Cowardly switches out if its HP becomes half or less.

WINDPOWER.name: Wind Power
WINDPOWER.desc: The Pokémon becomes charged when it is hit by a wind move, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move the Pokémon uses.

WINDRIDER.name: Wind Rider
WINDRIDER.desc: Boosts the Pokémon's Attack stat if Tailwind takes effect or if the Pokémon is hit by a wind move. The Pokémon also takes no damage from wind moves.

WONDERSKIN.name: Wonder Skin
WONDERSKIN.desc: Makes status-changing moves more likely to miss.

ZENMODE.name: Zen Mode
ZENMODE.desc: Changes the Pokémon's shape when HP is halved.

ZEROTOHERO.name: Zero to Hero
ZEROTOHERO.desc: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.
